question.text: The Annual Impact Report of a listed SE must be filed under SEBI LODR Regulations in which specific Part dealing with SSE-specific continuous disclosures?

explanation.text: The Logic: SEBI LODR Reg 33 Part VII is the SSE-specific continuous-disclosure chapter covering impact disclosures and the AIR. Reg 27 covers corporate governance, Reg 30 material events, Reg 33 Part I-VI financial results, Reg 44 general meetings. The Trap: LODR is a large regulation and the candidate who has only skimmed it may pick the financial-results regulation (Reg 33 general) without spotting the SSE-specific Part VII. Cross-Exam Context: III-A/III-C Compliance exams test LODR broadly; XXIII narrows to Part VII which is the SSE layer. Assessor's Pro-Tip: Keep a one-page map of LODR Parts VII/VIII alongside ICDR 292A-L on every engagement file. When you hand over documents to the SE's CS, reference the Part number so later compliance filings cite it verbatim.
